overview.description: The Direxion Daily SK Hynix Bull 2X ETF (SKHL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of SK hynix Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY) SKHL was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
